clips.prompt:
Use the supplied image as the EXACT CHARACTER AND ART STYLE reference. Draw animation frames of this same cartoon woman, NOT a new character. Preserve her rounded Japanese animation face, warm skin, dark-brown messy bun, cream loose short-sleeve shirt, sage-green loose cuffed trousers, bare feet, charming compact proportions, and deliberate square-pixel dark-brown outlines and cel-color clusters. No realistic person, 3D, mannequin, or vector stick figure.

Asset: six successive hand-drawn animation cels for ONE movement, on a transparent background. Production layout: an exact borderless 3-column by 2-row grid on a 1536x1024 canvas, so every cell is exactly 512x512. NO gutters, borders, labels, numbers, mat, ground, scenery, text, or shadows. Each cell contains one complete isolated woman. Absolutely no overlap across cell boundaries. Reading order is left-to-right, top row then bottom row. Every cell uses the SAME fixed camera, character scale, ground baseline at cell y=462, and bare feet at cell x=256. The standing body from sole to bun is about 350 pixels tall, leaving room for the raised arms. Consistent anatomy, exactly two arms and two legs.

The six drawings are chronological in-between frames of a calm sun salutation: from palms together at chest to both arms reaching straight overhead while standing upright, facing RIGHT in side profile. Feet and hips remain planted at exactly the same position in every cell.
Cell 1: identical relaxed standing prayer pose as the reference, hands together at sternum.
Cell 2: palms separate and hands move outward and upward to shoulder level, elbows bent.
Cell 3: both upper arms rise diagonally, hands near forehead level.
Cell 4: arms continue upward, elbows extend, hands above the crown.
Cell 5: arms nearly vertical, elbows almost straight, slight upward gaze.
Cell 6: final upward salute, arms fully extended overhead, hands close together, upright spine, gentle expression, no exaggerated backbend.
Make the motion increments clearly distinct and anatomically continuous, maintaining the SAME clothes, head size, silhouette treatment, and warm pixel-cel art throughout. Background truly transparent; do not paint white rectangles.

Cell 6: full standing forward fold, feet together, torso relaxed over thighs, head down, hands alongside feet on the ground. Do not turn her around.
